title: RAW UNREVIEWED: all-class circular nonreturning field capacity with arbitrary within-word cut
summary: Permit every whole group to be a rotation of a sequence of disjoint sign-class fields, each class occurring in at most one circular block. Unlike1321linear blocks, the first and last pieces may belong to one field. Circular cut constraints and admissible-set partitions can bound every possible class count without assuming class order, source language or word meanings.

design.mechanism: One fixed partition of working units into disjoint nonempty field classes; in each whole group, each used class occupies one circular interval. Both field order and cut position may differ by group. Internal symbol order inside fields is unrestricted.
design.unit: Each complete written group is considered cyclic only for this structural hypothesis; no circular manuscript reading direction or physical source identity is asserted.
design.exact_condition: For wordw oflengthn and candidate classC, count cyclic exits E_C(w)=sum_i 1[w_i inC and w_(i+1 mod n) notinC]. Require E_C(w)<=1. A one-class word has zero exits.
binary_cut_equivalence: For a proper nonempty subsetC, the total binary membership changes around a word equal2*E_C(w). Thus C is an admissible class iff every whole group has at most2cyclic changes for C versusits complement.

If a valid nontrivial K-class partition exists, isolate ANY one of its classes and merge all other classes into its complement. On a circle the complement of one interval is one interval, so a valid nontrivial binary partition exists. This special coarsening fact does not hold for arbitrary linear no-return partitions.
Conversely a valid binary partition is already a nontrivial partition. Therefore absence of ANY admissible nontrivial binary cut excludes everyK>=2in this circular family.

For a full capacity envelope, every block in any validpartition must be an admissible subsetC. Conversely any setpartition into admissible subsets satisfies the per-class circular condition. Maximizing the number of disjoint admissible subsets covering all active signs gives the exact maximumK, if independently certified. Otherwise report only justified bounds.
design.smallest_adequate_check: Freeze existing strict complete groups perreader; enumerate nonemptyproper subsets up to complement symmetry and reject any with a witnessed word having4or more cyclic class changes. Do not run an unbounded partition search if binary-cut results already settle the chosen decision. If maximumKis pursued, freeze a budget and provide independently replayable lower partition and upper cover certificate; do not call one surviving cut a wholewriter.

design.content_and_inverse_limit: This is a necessary record-field architecture, not a complete message writer. A field that straddles the cut is rejoined endfragment+startfragment when anotherclass locatesits boundaries. A word consisting of oneclass alone does not reveal its original within-field cyclic phase. Full reading needs a paid source framing rule; no lossless inverse is claimed by capacity.
limits: Not a changed decision for1321 or1345. No sorting ofletters withinclass and no globally fixed class order assumed.
Ordinary morphology with overlapping sign inventories, repeated field visits on the circle, class changes byword or altered glyph/group boundaries is outside.
